documentsRequired: As required on the official portal
title: UPPSC Exam Calendar 2026
vacancyDetails: Schedule of 80+ UPPSC examinations planned through 2026 including PCS and departmental exams
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppsc.up.nic.in
2. Open Examination Calendar under Examinations
3. Download UPPSC Exam Calendar 2026 PDF
4. Plan preparation as per tentative exam months
5. Watch for live advertisements for exact dates
shortDescription: UPPSC Exam Calendar 2026 out with full-year schedule (Feb–Dec 2026). Download from uppsc.up.nic.in.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Exam Calendar 2026.

The annual calendar lists tentative timelines for Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services (PCS) and numerous departmental examinations across the year (roughly February to December 2026).

Download the PDF from uppsc.up.nic.in (Examination Calendar). Exact application windows appear in individual advertisements such as Advt. A-1/E-1/2026 for PCS.
